constants.description: Evidence base is broken. The escalation action keys on this exact value as its primary trigger, so the two must be changed together.
constants.name: CONFIDENCE_LOW

decisions.description: Bands are evaluated in order and the first match wins, which is what resolves the overlap between the Low and Medium definitions: a record missing both verified financials and a complete profile is Low, because the harder failure governs. Every condition is a presence check. Deliberately no condition reads the credit SCORE or the disparity PERCENTAGE — those measure how good the deal is, and letting them move this field would turn a completeness signal into a lending opinion.
decisions.name: Confidence_Band
decisions.label: Confidence Band?

Flow.description: Deterministic grounding confidence: measures whether the evidence needed to assess this application is present, and never whether the application is any good. Stored as a band (100/50/20 on a Percent field), not a continuous score — the field renders as a percentage, so 100.00% reads as complete evidence. Runs before save, so it writes to the same record with no DML and cannot recurse. Run order against the disparity flow is declared explicitly: disparity 10, this flow 20 (triggerOrder, GA since API v54, a top-level Flow element). No dependency requires it today — the two before-save flows write disjoint field sets, this one never reads a disparity field and the disparity flow never reads a confidence field — so order cannot currently change the outcome. It is declared anyway, so that if either flow later reads what the other writes, the order is already defined rather than incidental. formulas.description: The raw list with its trailing separator removed. Written to Grounding_Signals_Missing__c so the escalation reason and the agent evidence trail can name the gaps without re-deriving this logic in a second place.
formulas.name: fmlSignalsMissing

formulas.description: Semicolon-separated list of absent signals, in the same order the decision evaluates them. Carries a trailing separator that fmlSignalsMissing strips. Names the missing evidence only — never a figure — so the string stays safe at Internal classification. One label per FIELD, never per rule: the earlier version emitted "complete applicant profile" for any of three fields and "verified financials" for either of two, so a reader could not tell which figure was actually absent. On a record missing only the declared revenue that read as a thin applicant record, and obscured the very thing the disparity control had abstained for. The applicant clause cannot currently fire — Applicant__c is required with deleteConstraint Restrict — but it is kept so this formula stays a faithful mirror of the Profile_Incomplete rule if that ever changes.
formulas.name: fmlSignalsMissingRaw
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!$Record.Verified_Annual_Revenue__c}), "verified revenue; ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!$Record.Verified_Net_Income__c}), "verified net income; ", "") & IF({!$Record.Needs_Financial_Review__c}, "statement flagged for review; ", "") & IF(BLANKVALUE({!$Record.Current_Credit_Checks__c}, 0) = 0, "current credit check; ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!$Record.Applicant__c}), "applicant; ", "") & IF(ISBLANK({!$Record.Declared_Annual_Revenue__c}), "declared revenue; ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT({!$Record.Security_Type__c})), "security type; ", "")
